section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex templates used as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, budget figures) not present in Tier 3.
Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed, or budget-dependent claims without a passing gate.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
A workflow or skill becoming a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions.
Finalising proposal text with incomplete/unvalidated source state without flagging the gap.
Using generic programme knowledge as a substitute for Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1–4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.
